tagline: Leading manufacturer and provider of products and services for residential, agtech, and infrastructure markets.
hero_kpi_rationale: The Residential segment represents over 80% of the company's total revenue following the acquisition of OmniMax, making it the primary driver of Gibraltar's performance.

kpis.name: Residential Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by the residential market products segment.
kpis.description: This segment includes roofing and rainwater management products, as well as building accessories, strengthened by the acquisition of OmniMax.
kpis.signal: The residential segment, the main growth driver, shows stable growth.

kpis.name: Agtech Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by the agricultural technology market products segment.
kpis.description: This segment serves institutional and commercial producers of fruits, vegetables, and flowers.
kpis.signal: Strong growth driven by the major acquisition of Lane Supply.

kpis.name: Infrastructure Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by the infrastructure market products segment.
kpis.description: This segment serves infrastructure construction projects, supported by robust demand and strong quoting activity.
kpis.signal: Modest but steady growth due to strong operational execution.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue remaining after deducting cost of goods sold.
kpis.description: Gross margin is a key indicator of profitability before operating expenses.
kpis.signal: Decline in gross margin due to an unfavorable product mix, partially offset by operational efficiency gains.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue remaining after deducting cost of goods sold and operating expenses.
kpis.description: Operating margin measures the profitability of the company's core operations.
kpis.signal: Operating margin declines, impacted by acquisition integration costs and product mix.

kpis.name: SG&A Expenses (% of Revenue)
kpis.explanation: Selling, general, and administrative expenses as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: These expenses include marketing, sales, and administrative costs. The increase is primarily due to businesses acquired in 2025.
kpis.signal: Increase in overhead expenses related to acquisitions and associated costs, partially offset by reduced performance bonuses.

kpis.name: Consolidated Backlog
kpis.explanation: Total value of customer orders not yet fulfilled.
kpis.description: The backlog indicates expected future demand for the company's products and services.
kpis.signal: Backlog doubles, signaling strong future demand.

kpis.name: Agtech Backlog
kpis.explanation: Value of customer orders not yet fulfilled in the Agtech segment.
kpis.description: This KPI reflects strong demand momentum in the agricultural technology sector, including organic growth of 187%.
kpis.signal: Exponential growth in Agtech backlog, driven by the acquisition of Lane Supply and new projects.

kpis.name: Agtech Backlog (Organic Growth)
kpis.explanation: Growth in customer orders not yet fulfilled in the Agtech segment, excluding acquisitions.
kpis.description: Organic growth in the Agtech backlog highlights the relevance of the company's products in the agricultural technology market.
kpis.signal: Strong organic growth in Agtech backlog, indicating sustained underlying demand beyond acquisition effects.

ai_positioning.summary: Gibraltar Industries does not have an explicit positioning or specific mention regarding AI in the 10-K. The company operates in industrial and residential markets where AI is not presented as a direct revenue driver or differentiating capability.
